rationale: Overload groups (N declarations + 1 implementation) must keep the LAST declaration: it carries the full parameter list and the body. First-wins dedupe kept the body-less SIGNATURE - complexity 1, no qualified_calls, no taint data - while the relationship walker still emitted body-derived call edges sourced from that same symbol. The kept symbol must expose the implementation's params (id + opts), its decision points (if -> complexity 2) and its qualified calls.
